The code should iteratively refine the mesh based on the recovery estimate until the error is below the specified threshold. The code should also coarsen the mesh after each time step. ```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from fealpy.mesh import TriangleMesh
from fealpy.functionspace import LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d
from fealpy.timeintegratoralg import UniformTimeLine
from fealpy.pde.heat_conduction_2d import HeatConductionData2d  # Example PDE data
from fealpy.tools.show import showmultirate

def solve_heat_conduction_adaptive(
    nx=10, ny=10, nt=20, 
    refine_threshold=1e-3, 
    refine_theta=0.3, 
    coarsen_theta=0.05, 
    T=0.1, 
    plot_steps=None
):
    # PDE data
    pde = HeatConductionData2d()
    # Initial mesh
    domain = pde.domain()
    mesh = TriangleMesh.from_box(domain, nx=nx, ny=ny)
    # Time discretization
    timeline = UniformTimeLine(0, T, nt)
    dt = timeline.current_time_step_length()
    # Finite element space
    space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
    # Initial condition
    u0 = space.interpolation(pde.init_value)
    uh = u0.copy()
    # Dirichlet boundary
    is_dirichlet = mesh.boundary_node_index()
    # For error plot
    error_list = []
    time_list = []
    # Plot steps
    if plot_steps is None:
        plot_steps = [0, nt//2, nt-1]
    # Time stepping
    for k in range(0, nt):
        t1 = timeline.next_time_level()
        # Assemble matrices
        A = space.stiff_matrix()
        M = space.mass_matrix()
        F = space.source_vector(lambda x: pde.source(x, t1))
        # Backward Euler: (M + dt*A) u^{n+1} = M u^n + dt*F
        b = M @ uh + dt * F
        AA = M + dt * A
        # Apply Dirichlet BC
        bc = pde.dirichlet
        is_bd = mesh.is_boundary_node()
        bd_idx = np.where(is_bd)[0]
        bd_val = bc(mesh.node[bd_idx], t1)
        from fealpy.tools import apply_dirichlet_bc
        uh1 = np.zeros_like(uh)
        apply_dirichlet_bc(AA, b, bd_idx, bd_val, uh1)
        # Solve
        from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve
        uh1 = spsolve(AA, b)
        uh[~is_bd] = uh1[~is_bd]
        uh[is_bd] = bd_val
        # Adaptive refinement loop
        while True:
            # Recovery-based error estimator
            from fealpy.recovery import FEMFunctionRecoveryAlg
            recovery = FEMFunctionRecoveryAlg(space, uh)
            eta = recovery.recover_estimate()
            max_eta = np.max(eta)
            print(f"Time step {k}, refinement error estimator: {max_eta:.4e}")
            # Plot mesh
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.gca()
            mesh.add_plot(ax)
            plt.title(f"Mesh at time {k}, refinement")
            plt.savefig(f"mesh_refine_t{k}.png")
            plt.close(fig)
            if max_eta < refine_threshold:
                break
            # Mark for refinement
            from fealpy.adaptive import AdaptiveMarker
            marker = AdaptiveMarker(eta)
            cell_mark = marker.refine_mark(refine_theta)
            mesh, idx = mesh.refine_triangle_rg(cell_mark)
            # Update space and uh
            space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
            uh = space.interpolation(lambda x: uh[x])
        # Coarsening
        from fealpy.adaptive import AdaptiveMarker
        marker = AdaptiveMarker(eta)
        cell_mark = marker.coarsen_mark(coarsen_theta)
        if np.any(cell_mark):
            mesh, idx = mesh.coarsen_triangle_nvb(cell_mark)
            space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
            uh = space.interpolation(lambda x: uh[x])
            # Plot mesh after coarsening
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.gca()
            mesh.add_plot(ax)
            plt.title(f"Mesh at time {k}, coarsening")
            plt.savefig(f"mesh_coarsen_t{k}.png")
            plt.close(fig)
        # Error computation
        l2err = space.integralalg.L2_error(pde.solution, uh, timeline.current_time_level())
        print(f"Time step {k}, L2 error: {l2err:.4e}")
        error_list.append(l2err)
        time_list.append(timeline.current_time_level())
        # Plot solution at specified steps
        if k in plot_steps:
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.gca(projection='3d')
            space.show_function(ax, uh, cmap='rainbow')
            plt.title(f"Numerical solution at t={timeline.current_time_level():.3f}")
            plt.savefig(f"solution_t{k}.png")
            plt.close(fig)
        # Prepare for next step
        uh = uh.copy()
        timeline.advance()
    # Plot error history
    plt.figure()
    plt.semilogy(time_list, error_list, marker='o')
    plt.xlabel('Time')
    plt.ylabel('L2 Error')
    plt.title('L2 Error vs Time')
    plt.savefig('error_history.png')
    plt.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve_heat_conduction_adaptive(
        nx=8, ny=8, nt=20, 
        refine_threshold=1e-3, 
        refine_theta=0.3, 
        coarsen_theta=0.05, 
        T=0.1, 
        plot_steps=[0, 10, 19]
    )
